title: The Refusing Frontier

features.name: boundary dissolving
features.desc-on-touch: where you stand, the frontier refuses to exist. no line holds here.

features.name: threshold arch
features.desc-on-touch: a doorway that opens to both sides at once, that refuses to choose which way is arrival.

features.name: unnamed monument
features.desc-on-touch: a structure that remembers refusing its own name. all plaques here read blank.

features.name: circuit of refusal
features.desc-on-touch: paths here lead both nowhere and everywhere. the map refuses to complete itself.

features.name: liminal clearing
features.desc-on-touch: no one arrives here and no one departs. this is the place between leaving and staying.

inscription: here the frontier refuses itself—neither arrival nor departure, but the breath between them

file.name: Border_Refusals_Unsigned_Field_Notes.txt
file.note: accounts of travelers who arrived at this place and discovered they had never been leaving

exits.label: back toward the country that exists only at thresholds
